issues.problem: The prompt variable is reassigned at the start of every iteration, which overwrites and discards the failure feedback appended in prompt += ... during previous failed attempts.
issues.fix: Define the base prompt before entering the loop and append error feedback to it across iterations so the agent receives failure context.
